spec.statistical_unit: heldout scene; average its four independent source pulses first
spec.dependence_limit: Four heldout scenes within a fold share the same four source pulses. Eight-scene bootstrap is conditional on these sources and not a full independent-source/population interval. Report fold means and crossed source/target resampling as sensitivity, not independent replication.
spec.unknown: Exclude unknown from numerator and denominator; report and fail completeness when any remain. Never convert unknown to failure.
spec.primary: 128 fixed queries; scene-equal analytic feasibility difference
spec.rescue_harm: Paired candidate IDs vs original checkpoint and same-source/step R0; report both rather than only net change.
spec.pipeline: G0S0/G1S0/G0S1/G1S1 each use full official collision/NMS/objectTop10/Top50 selection; top1, feasible count and candidate coverage separate.
spec.ranking: Within-object success/failure pair inversions on the same known fixed-query ID intersection; compare old/new scores at each frozen geometry. Equal weight objects within source/scene, then sources within scene. Diagnostic, not AP.
spec.decision: No best-step selection. Loss descent, gradient norm or oracle gains alone are not benefit. Require consistent treated-vs-R0 evidence surviving count and actual-step controls; small pulse evidence cannot establish a method or generalization.
